eval.formatCli: parseEvalImportFormat trims/lowercases and rejects anything outside its exact seven-format set; evalImportCli forwards workspace,file,agentId,historical only.
eval.parseRaw: parseRawJsonOrJsonl reads/trims a real file; empty input throws; attempts whole JSON then parses nonblank JSONL lines, naming the first invalid line. No format producer or parser mock needed.
eval.timestampParsing: parseCaseTimestamp checks ts,timestamp,created_at,createdAt,completed_at,completedAt,updated_at,updatedAt across each format's actual sources. timestampFromUnknown accepts finite numeric values: >10,000,000,000 rounded milliseconds, otherwise rounded seconds*1,000; nonblank strings use Date.parse; invalid/missing returns null.
eval.timePolicy: One now=Date.now is captured after full parsing. Every parsed case is filtered with strict >now+5min or <now-24h. Any out-of-window case throws before resolveAgentId/session/start/openLedger unless historical===true. Constants remain source-labelled proposed defaults, not new approved policy.
eval.timeError: Refusing eval import: <n> case(s) are timestamped more than 5 minutes ahead or more than 24 hours ago (<IDs>). Events are recorded at import time; pass --historical to import them as historical, keeping each case's own time as meta.claimedTs.
eval.writer: const trustTier=SELF_REPORTED. Opens actual ledger, starts signed session, appends started audit, real case/test and mapped metric events (calibration/failure records when applicable), completed audit, seals session, closes in finally. No item.ts is passed as event ts. caseTime claimedTs/historical appears on per-case records; started/completed audit has no case timestamp.
eval.atomicScope: Whole-file time validation occurs before any ledger call. This is not general transaction rollback for IO failures after writing begins.
